statement: The most pressing question is whether we can achieve a 4/3-approximation for the girth in subquadratic time. If it is not the case then, what is the best approximation factor we can get in subquadratic time? We note that in [17], Roditty and Vassilevska Williams conjectured that we cannot achieve a (2 − ε)-approximation already for unweighted graphs5 .
